subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should the Bedrock plugin expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields` or `providerFields` passthrough, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option, or no user-configurable beta flag surface?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding a provider request-field config contract is a compatibility-sensitive product/API decision under the repository policy.

options.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
options.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely merges request fields, validates shape, documents upgrade behavior, and covers `anthropic_beta` without adding a core-generic passthrough.

options.title: Add only a narrow beta flag
options.body: Support a typed Bedrock `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` path for Claude long context while avoiding a general Converse body passthrough.

options.title: Decline configurable betas
options.body: Keep Bedrock request shaping internal and require first-class provider support for each beta feature before exposing it to users.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely merges request fields, validates shape, documents upgrade behavior, and covers `anthropic_beta` without adding a core-generic passthrough.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the Bedrock plugin boundary and the repository's public config-surface policy, both areas reflected in recent history.
